#include<stdio.h>
int main() {
 int i,j,AH,AM,AS,BH,BM,BS,H,M,S;
 scanf("%d",&j);
 for(i=0; i<j; i++) {
 H=M=S=0;
 scanf("%d %d %d %d %d %d",&AH,&AM,&AS,&BH,&BM,&BS);
 S=AS+BS;
 if(S>=60) {
 S=S-60;
 M=M+1;
 }
 M=M+AM+BM;
 if(M>=60) {
 M=M-60;
 H=H+1;
 }
 H=H+AH+BH;
 printf("%d %d %d\n",H,M,S);
 }
 return 0;
}
